desc:
💨 Welcome to DON'T FART!

DON'T FART, THEY CAN SMELL IT

How to Play:
💨 Your fart gauge fills up during the run, hold it in!
🟢 Reach a safe zone before it's full to let it out safely
👃 Fart outside a safe zone and the nearest Sniffer comes for you
🦘 Jump from platform to platform, the current drags you back if you fall
🧪 Use Stink Bombs, Fart Jars and Pepper Bombs to lure or stun the Sniffers
🤝 Revive your downed teammates... or tickle them to make them fart 😈
⬆️ Unlock tools and upgrades with coins
🏆 Escape every room to beat Normal and unlock Hard mode!

👥 Play solo or with up to 4 friends
🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
